feeds.title: On the Home Front
feeds.description: The National Low Income Housing Coalition is dedicated solely to achieving socially just public policy that assures people with the lowest incomes in the United States have affordable and decent homes.

feeds.title: Shelterforce
feeds.description: Shelterforce covers topics from community planning to racial equity, housing affordability to homeownership, and the future of community development. Shelterforce is the only independent, non-academic publication covering the worlds of community development, affordable housing, and neighborhood stabilization.

feeds.title: NYU Furman Center
feeds.description: News and analysis on real estate and land use from Furman Center researchers. The Furman Center for Real Estate & Urban Policy is a leading academic research center devoted to the public policy aspects of real estate, land use and housing development.

feeds.title: Navigate Housing Blog
feeds.description: Get tips, tricks & advice on how to manage affordable housing projects, how to become a certified public housing manager, and more. Navigate Affordable Housing Partners is a nonprofit that actively works to enhance all aspects of the housing industry to ensure that people have access to quality, livable housing choices.

feeds.title: Habitat LA Blog
feeds.description: Habitat LA has an open-door policy. We welcome anyone who shares our belief that everyone needs a safe, decent, affordable place to live, regardless of race, religion, age, gender, political views or any of the other distinctions that too often divide people. We believe shelter is a basic human need and Habitat LA strives to achieve its goal of eliminating substandard housing by making decent, sustainable and affordable housing a reality for all.

feeds.title: Affordable Housing Blog
feeds.description: Find the latest blog posts related to Affordable Housing at One Stop Housing. One Stop Housing offers the smartest and most affordable housing across central Florida and Memphis, TN. We offer the greatest diversity of convenient and affordable rentals including apartments, studios, duplexes, villas, townhomes and houses.

feeds.title: Multifamily Insiders Blog » Affordable Housing
feeds.description: Covers all topics important to affordable housing operators, including tax credit, section 8, vouchers, and other affordable housing topics. Multifamily Insiders was created to provide the first true online networking group for the multifamily industry and its partners.Our goal is to help coordinate professionals within our ranks, share knowledge, and brainstorm the future of apartment living.

feeds.title: Affordable Housing Action Blog
feeds.description: Health, Homelessness and Affordable Housing News. This blog focuses on housing for people who don't have it and those who are struggling to hang on to it. We report successes. We also report the limitations of private market solutions and stop gap measures that fall short.

feeds.title: VAHC Blog
feeds.description: Find the latest information about what's happening at our member organizations, opportunities in the community, and the latest news from the Legislature. VAHC is a dynamic statewide partnership dedicated to uniting people in a movement for safe, accessible, quality, and perpetually affordable housing. We accomplish this through advocacy, education, and outreach.

feeds.title: The NAHRO Blog
feeds.description: Updates & Analysis on federal housing & community development regulations & legislation. Key topics covered are Community Development, Federal Funding & Regulation, Eviction, and Public Housing. NAHRO is a leading membership association for professionals in the housing & community development industry.
